title.zh: 卷四十一 志第十一: 地理志五
title.raw: 卷四十一 志第十一: 地理志五 Volume 41 Treatises 11: Geography 5

translations.literal: Geography Treatise V: Western Capital Circuit
translations.idiomatic: Geography Treatise V — Western Capital (Xijing) Circuit

sentences.zh: 西京大同府，陶唐冀州之域。

translations.literal: Western Capital Datong Prefecture—the land of Ji in Yao's era.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Prefecture at the Western Capital was ancient Ji territory under Yao.

translations.literal: In Shun's time it was allotted to Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Shun assigned it to Bing Province.

translations.literal: Under Xia it again belonged to Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xia it returned to Ji Province.

translations.literal: The Zhou Offices of Region call the due north Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou Offices of Region name the north Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 戰國屬趙，武靈王始置雲中郡。

translations.literal: In the Warring States it belonged to Zhao; King Wuling first established Yunzhong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the Warring States era it lay in Zhao; King Wuling of Zhao first created Yunzhong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 秦屬代王國，後為平城縣。

translations.literal: Under Qin it belonged to the Dai princely kingdom; later it became Pingcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Qin placed it in the princely kingdom of Dai; later it was Pingcheng County.

translations.literal: Under Wei it belonged to Xinxing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei it fell within Xinxing Commandery.

translations.literal: Jin still assigned it to Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jin it remained in Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 劉琨表封猗盧為代王，都平城。

translations.literal: Liu Kun memorialized to enfeoff Yilu as Prince of Dai, with capital at Pingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kun petitioned to enfeoff Yilu as Prince of Dai with his seat at Pingcheng.

sentences.zh: 元魏道武於此遂建都邑。

translations.literal: Northern Wei Emperor Daowu hereupon founded his capital seat.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei's Emperor Daowu founded his capital here.

sentences.zh: 孝文帝改為司州牧，置代尹，遷都洛邑，改萬年，又置恒州。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowen changed it to Sizhou pastoral supervisor, set a Dai intendant, moved the capital to Luoyang, renamed it Wannian, and also established Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowen made it Sizhou pastoral domain, appointed a Dai intendant, relocated the capital to Luoyang, renamed the seat Wannian, and added Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 高齊文宣帝廢州為恒安鎮，今謂之東城，尋復恒州。

translations.literal: Northern Qi Emperor Wenxuan abolished the prefecture for Heng'an Fort; today this is called the Eastern City; soon Heng Prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi Emperor Wenxuan reduced the prefecture to Heng'an Fort—today's Eastern City—then restored Heng Prefecture.

translations.literal: Zhou again made Heng'an Fort and changed the name to Shuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou reinstated Heng'an Fort as Shuo Prefecture.

translations.literal: Sui still kept it as a fort.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui it remained a fortified post.

sentences.zh: 唐武德四年置北恒州，七年廢。

translations.literal: Tang year 4 of Wude established Northern Heng Prefecture; year 7 it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Wude year 4 set up Northern Heng Prefecture; in year 7 it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十四年，移雲中定襄縣於此。

translations.literal: Zhenguan year 14 moved Yunzhong's Dingxiang County here.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan year 14 Dingxiang County from Yunzhong was moved here.

sentences.zh: 永淳元年，默啜為民患，移民朔州。

translations.literal: Yongchun year 1, Mochuo troubled the people; populations were moved to Shuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongchun year 1 Mochuo's raids harried the people, and the populace was relocated to Shuo.

translations.literal: Kaiyuan year 18 established Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan year 18 created Yun Prefecture.

translations.literal: Tianbao year 1 changed it to Yunzhong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao year 1 it became Yunzhong Commandery.

translations.literal: Qianyuan year 1 it was called Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyuan year 1 it reverted to the name Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乾符三年，大同軍節度使李國昌子克用為雲中守捉使，殺防禦使，據州以聞。

translations.literal: Qianfu year 3, Datong Army military commissioner Li Guochang's son Keyong served as Yunzhong defense commissioner, killed the defense envoy, held the prefecture and reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianfu year 3 Li Guochang's son Keyong, of the Datong Army command, was Yunzhong defense commissioner; he slew the defense envoy, seized the prefecture, and sent word to court.

sentences.zh: 僖宗赦克用，以國昌為大同軍防禦使，不受命。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong pardoned Keyong, making Guochang Datong Army defense envoy; he did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong amnestied Keyong and appointed Guochang Datong Army defense envoy, but Guochang refused the order.

sentences.zh: 廣明元年，李琢攻國昌，國昌兵敗，與克用奔北地。

translations.literal: Guangming year 1, Li Zhuo attacked Guochang; Guochang's army was defeated and with Keyong fled to the Northern Land.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangming year 1 Li Zhuo struck Guochang; defeated, Guochang fled north with Keyong.

sentences.zh: 黃巢入京師，詔發代北軍，尋赦國昌，使討賊。

translations.literal: Huang Chao entered the capital; an edict raised the Dai-north armies; soon Guochang was pardoned and ordered to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao took the capital, court ordered the Dai-north armies mobilized and soon pardoned Guochang to campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 克用率三萬五千騎而南，收京師功第一，國昌封隴西郡王。

translations.literal: Keyong led thirty-five thousand cavalry south; in recovering the capital his merit ranked first; Guochang was enfeoffed Prince of Longxi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong marched south with thirty-five thousand horsemen; his service in retaking the capital ranked first, and Guochang was made Prince of Longxi Commandery.

translations.literal: Guochang died; Keyong took Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After Guochang died, Keyong seized Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 既而所向失利，乃卑詞厚禮，與太祖會於雲州之東城，謀大舉兵攻梁，不果。

translations.literal: Soon afterward his campaigns met reverses; he then sent humble words and rich gifts and met the Taizu at Yun Prefecture's Eastern City to plan a great attack on Liang, but it did not come to pass.
translations.idiomatic: When his campaigns faltered, Keyong sent humble envoys and lavish gifts to meet the Taizu at Yun Prefecture's Eastern City and plot a major strike against Liang—but the plan never materialized.

sentences.zh: 克用子存勖滅梁，是為唐莊宗。

translations.literal: Keyong's son Cunxu destroyed Liang; this was Tang Emperor Zhuangzong.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong's son Cunxu overthrew Liang and became Tang Emperor Zhuangzong.

sentences.zh: 同光三年，復以雲州為大同軍節度使。

translations.literal: Tongguang year 3 again made Yun Prefecture the seat of the Datong Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongguang year 3 Yun Prefecture was again the headquarters of the Datong Army command.

sentences.zh: 晉高祖代唐，以契丹有援立功，割山前、代北地為賂，大同來屬，因建西京。

translations.literal: Jin Emperor Gaozu replaced Tang; because the Khitan had aided him and won merit, he ceded the lands south of the mountains and north of Dai as tribute; Datong came under Liao rule and the Western Capital was established.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin Gaozu supplanted Tang he rewarded Khitan aid by ceding the mountain-front and northern Dai territories; Datong passed to Liao and the Western Capital was founded.

translations.literal: Enemy towers and palisades were complete.
translations.idiomatic: Watchtowers and stockades were fully built.

translations.literal: Twenty li in length and breadth.
translations.idiomatic: The city measured twenty li on each side.

sentences.zh: 門，東曰迎春，南曰朝陽，西曰定西，北曰拱極。

translations.literal: Gates: east called Yingchun, south Chaoyang, west Dingxi, north Gongji.
translations.idiomatic: Its gates were Yingchun to the east, Chaoyang to the south, Dingxi to the west, and Gongji to the north.

sentences.zh: 元魏宮垣占城之北面，雙闕尚在。

translations.literal: Northern Wei palace walls occupied the city's north face; paired gate towers still stand.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei palace ramparts took up the north side of the city; the paired gate towers remain.

sentences.zh: 遼既建都，用為重地，非親王不得主之。

translations.literal: Once Liao had established its capital here it was treated as a weighty post; none but imperial princes might govern it.
translations.idiomatic: After Liao made this a capital seat it became a place of high importance—only princes of the blood could hold it.

sentences.zh: 清寧八年建華巖寺，奉安諸帝石像、銅像。

translations.literal: In Qingning year 8 Huayan Temple was built to enshrine stone and bronze images of the emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Qingning year 8 saw Huayan Temple erected to house stone and bronze imperial images.

sentences.zh: 又有天王寺、留守司衙，南曰西省。

translations.literal: There were also Tianwang Temple and the headquarters of the resident commissioner; to the south was called the Western Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The city also held Tianwang Temple and the resident commissioner's yamen; the southern quarter was called the Western Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 北門之東曰大同府，北門之西曰大同驛。

translations.literal: East of the north gate was Datong Prefecture; west of the north gate was Datong Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: East of the North Gate lay Datong Prefecture; west of it lay Datong Post Station.

sentences.zh: 初為大同軍節度，重熙十三年升為西京，府曰大同。

translations.literal: At first it was the Datong Army command; in Chongxi year 13 it was raised to the Western Capital, the prefecture called Datong.
translations.idiomatic: It began as the Datong Army headquarters; in Chongxi year 13 it was promoted to Western Capital with Datong as the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: It governed two prefectures and seven counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two sub-prefectures and seven counties:

translations.literal: Datong County.
translations.idiomatic: Datong County.

translations.literal: Originally the land of Datong River valley.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally the Datong River valley.

sentences.zh: 重熙十七年西夏犯邊，析雲中縣置。

translations.literal: In Chongxi year 17 when Western Xia raided the border, it was split off from Yunzhong County and established.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxi year 17, after a Western Xia border raid, it was carved from Yunzhong County.

translations.literal: Ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Yunzhong County.
translations.idiomatic: Yunzhong County.

translations.literal: Established by Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao founded it.

translations.literal: Its administrative history matches that of the capital prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its administrative history follows that of the capital seat.

translations.literal: Ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Tiancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Tiancheng County.

translations.literal: Originally the outermost frontier land.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally the outermost frontier territory.

sentences.zh: 魏道武帝置廣牧縣，唐武德五年置定襄縣，遼析雲中置。

translations.literal: Northern Wei Emperor Daowu set Guangmu County; Tang Wude year 5 set Dingxiang County; Liao split it from Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei Daowu created Guangmu County; Tang Wude year 5 added Dingxiang County; Liao carved it from Yunzhong.

translations.literal: One hundred eighty li north of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred eighty li north of the capital.

translations.literal: Five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Changqing County.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing County.

translations.literal: Originally the land of Baideng Platform.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally Baideng Platform.

sentences.zh: 冒頓單于縱精騎三十餘萬圍漢高帝於白登七日，即此。

translations.literal: The Xiongnu chanyu Modu with more than three hundred thousand elite cavalry besieged Han Emperor Gaodi at Baideng for seven days—this was the place.
translations.idiomatic: Here the Xiongnu chanyu Modu with over three hundred thousand picked horsemen besieged Han Emperor Gaodi at Baideng for seven days.

translations.literal: Liao first established the county.
translations.idiomatic: Liao first created the county.

translations.literal: There is Qingpo.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingpo marsh lies there.

sentences.zh: 梁元帝《橫吹曲》云「朝跋青陂，暮上白登。

translations.literal: Liang Emperor Yuan's Hengchui song says: "At dawn we ford Qingpo; at dusk we climb Baideng.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Emperor Yuan's Hengchui lyric runs: "At dawn we ford Qingpo; at dusk we climb Baideng.

translations.literal: " It lies one hundred ten li north of Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: " It stood one hundred ten li north of Eastern Capital.

translations.literal: Four thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Four thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Fengyi County.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyi County.

translations.literal: Originally Han Taolin County land.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally Han Taolin County.

translations.literal: Later Tang Emperor Wu met the Taizu here.
translations.idiomatic: Later Tang's Emperor Wu met the Taizu here.

translations.literal: Liao split it from Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Liao carved it from Yunzhong County.

translations.literal: Three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Huairen County.
translations.idiomatic: Huairen County.

translations.literal: Originally Han Shanan County.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally Han Shanan County.

translations.literal: Northern Wei Ge Rong's rebellion; the county was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: During Northern Wei Ge Rong's revolt the county was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇二年移雲內於此。

translations.literal: Sui Kaihuang year 2 moved Yunnei here.
translations.idiomatic: Sui Kaihuang year 2 relocated Yunnei here.

sentences.zh: 大業二年置大利縣，屬雲州，改屬定襄郡。

translations.literal: Daye year 2 established Dali County, belonging to Yun Prefecture; later it was changed to Dingxiang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Daye year 2 created Dali County under Yun Prefecture, later reassigned to Dingxiang Commandery.

translations.literal: At the end of Sui it fell to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In late Sui it was lost to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 李克用敗赫連鐸，駐兵於此。

translations.literal: Li Keyong defeated Helian Duo and encamped here.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong defeated Helian Duo and stationed troops here.

translations.literal: Liao changed the name to Huairen.
translations.idiomatic: Liao renamed it Huairen.

translations.literal: Sixty li south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay sixty li south of the capital.

translations.literal: Three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Huai'an County.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an County.

translations.literal: Originally Han Yiyu County land.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally Han Yiyu County.

sentences.zh: 歷魏至隋，為突厥所據，唐克頡利，縣遂廢為懷荒鎮。

translations.literal: From Wei through Sui it was held by the Turks; Tang conquered Jieli and the county was abolished for Huaihuang Fort.
translations.idiomatic: From Wei through Sui Turks held it; after Tang defeated Jieli the county was abolished and became Huaihuang Fort.

sentences.zh: 高勛鎮燕，奏分歸化州文德縣置。

translations.literal: When Gao Xun governed Yan he memorialized to split off Wende County of Guihua Prefecture and establish this.
translations.idiomatic: Under Gao Xun's rule in Yan he petitioned to carve Wende County from Guihua Prefecture and establish this county.

translations.literal: At first it was subordinate to Fengsheng Prefecture; later it came under this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Initially it answered to Fengsheng Prefecture; later it was transferred here.

translations.literal: Two hundred eighty li northwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It stood two hundred eighty li northwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Hong Prefecture, Boling Army, lower grade, cishi.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Prefecture—Boning Army, lower grade, with a prefect.

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Emperor Jing established Northern Lingqiu County.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei Emperor Jing founded Northern Lingqiu County.

sentences.zh: 唐初地陷突厥，開元中置橫野軍安邊縣，天寶亂廢，後為襄陰村。

translations.literal: Early Tang the land fell to the Turks; in Kaiyuan a Hengye Army and Anbian County were set up; abolished in the Tianbao turmoil; later it was Xiangyin village.
translations.idiomatic: Early Tang lost the region to Turks; Kaiyuan saw Hengye Army and Anbian County, abolished in the Tianbao disorders; later it became Xiangyin village.

sentences.zh: 統和中，以寰州近邊，為宋將潘美所破，廢之，乃於此置弘州，初軍曰永寧。

translations.literal: In Tonghe, because Huan Prefecture lay on the border and was broken by Song general Pan Mei, it was abolished and Hong Prefecture was established here; at first the army was called Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: During Tonghe, after border prefecture Huan was smashed by Song general Pan Mei and abolished, Hong Prefecture was founded here; its army was first called Yongning.

sentences.zh: 有桑乾河、白道泉、白登山，亦曰火燒山，有火井。

translations.literal: There are the Sanggan River, Baidao Spring, Mount Baideng—also called Mount Huoshao—and a fire well.
translations.idiomatic: It has the Sanggan River, Baidao Spring, Mount Baideng (also Mount Huoshao), and a fire well.

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

translations.literal: Yongning County.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning County.

translations.literal: Ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Shunsheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Shunsheng County.

translations.literal: Originally Northern Wei Anse Army; abolished in Five Dynasties warfare.
translations.idiomatic: It was Northern Wei's Anse Army, abandoned amid Five Dynasties fighting.

sentences.zh: 高勛鎮幽州，奏景宗分永興縣置。

translations.literal: When Gao Xun governed Youzhou he memorialized for Emperor Jingzong to split off Yongxing County and establish this.
translations.idiomatic: Under Gao Xun in Youzhou he petitioned Emperor Jingzong to carve Yongxing County and establish this county.

translations.literal: At first subordinate to Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It initially answered to Fengsheng Prefecture.

translations.literal: Two hundred eighty li northwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It stood two hundred eighty li northwest of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand registered households.

translations.literal: De Prefecture, lower grade, cishi.
translations.idiomatic: De Prefecture, lower grade, with a prefect.

sentences.zh: 唐會昌中以西德店置德州。

translations.literal: Tang Huichang era established De Prefecture at Xide post.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang's Huichang period De Prefecture was set up at Xide post.

translations.literal: Kaitai year 8 restored it with Han households.
translations.idiomatic: Kaitai year 8 it was re-established for Han settlers.

sentences.zh: 有步落泉、金河山、野狐嶺、白道阪。

translations.literal: There are Buluo Spring, Jinhe Mountain, Yehu Ridge, and Baidao Slope.
translations.idiomatic: It has Buluo Spring, Jinhe Mountain, Yehu Ridge, and Baidao Slope.

translations.literal: One county:
translations.idiomatic: One county:

translations.literal: Xuande County.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande County.

sentences.zh: 本漢桐過縣地，屬雲中郡，後隸定襄郡，漢末廢。

translations.literal: Originally Han Tongguo County land, belonging to Yunzhong Commandery; later subordinate to Dingxiang Commandery; abolished at the end of Han.
translations.idiomatic: It was Han Tongguo County in Yunzhong Commandery, later in Dingxiang Commandery, abandoned in late Han.

translations.literal: Northern Qi set Zi'a Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi established Zi'a Fort.

translations.literal: Tang Huichang era established the county.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's Huichang period created the county.

translations.literal: Three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Zhenwu County.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenwu County.

translations.literal: Originally Han Dingxiang Commandery Shengle County.
translations.idiomatic: It was Han Dingxiang Commandery's Shengle County.

translations.literal: Backed by the Yin Mountains, fronting the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: It lay against the Yin Mountains with the Yellow River before it.

translations.literal: Northern Wei once made Shengle its capital—this was the place.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei once held its capital at Shengle—here.

sentences.zh: 唐武德四年克突厥，建雲中都督府。

translations.literal: Tang Wude year 4 conquered the Turks and built the Yunzhong area command.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Wude year 4, after defeating the Turks, established the Yunzhong area command.

sentences.zh: 麟德三年改單于大都督府。

translations.literal: Linde year 3 changed it to the Chanyu grand area command.
translations.idiomatic: Linde year 3 it became the Chanyu grand area command.

sentences.zh: 聖歷元年又改安北都督。

translations.literal: Shengli year 1 again changed it to the Anbei area command.
translations.idiomatic: Shengli year 1 it was renamed the Anbei area command.

sentences.zh: 開元七年割隸東受降城。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan year 7 cut off and subordinated to Eastern Shouxiang Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan year 7 it was detached and placed under Eastern Shouxiang Fort.

translations.literal: Year 8 established the Zhenwu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Year 8 created the Zhenwu Army command.

sentences.zh: 會昌五年為安北都護府。

translations.literal: Huichang year 5 it became the Anbei grand protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Huichang year 5 the seat was raised to the Anbei grand protectorate.

sentences.zh: 後唐莊宗以兄嗣本為振武節度使。

translations.literal: Later Tang Emperor Zhuangzong appointed his elder brother Siben Zhenwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Later Tang Zhuangzong made his elder brother Siben military commissioner of Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 太祖神冊元年，伐吐渾還，攻之，盡俘其民以東，唯存鄉兵三百人防戍。

translations.literal: Taizu year 1 of divine enthronement, returning from campaigning against the Tuyuhun, attacked it and took all its people east; only three hundred local militia remained to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizu's first year of divine enthronement, returning from a Tuyuhun campaign, he attacked the place, deported the entire population eastward, and left only three hundred local militia on guard.

translations.literal: Later it was again made a county.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was restored as a county.

translations.literal: Yunnei Prefecture, Kaiyuan Army, lower grade, military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnei Prefecture—Kaiyuan Army, lower grade, with a military commissioner.

translations.literal: Originally Middle Shouxiang Fort land.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally Middle Shouxiang Fort.

sentences.zh: 遼初置代北雲朔招討司，改雲內州。

translations.literal: At the founding of Liao the Dai-north Yun-Shuo pacification office was set up; changed to Yunnei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early Liao placed the Dai-north Yun-Shuo pacification office here, later renamed Yunnei Prefecture.

translations.literal: Early Qingning it was promoted.
translations.idiomatic: It was raised in rank at the start of Qingning.

sentences.zh: 有威塞軍、古可敦城、大同川、天安軍、永濟柵、安樂戍、拂雲堆。

translations.literal: There are Weisai Army, ancient Khotan city, Datong River valley, Tian'an Army, Yongji Palisade, Anle garrison, and Fuyun Mound.
translations.idiomatic: It has Weisai Army, ancient Khotan city, the Datong River valley, Tian'an Army, Yongji Palisade, Anle garrison, and Fuyun Mound.

translations.literal: Military affairs belonged to the Southwest Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: Its military affairs came under the Southwest Pacification Office.

translations.literal: It governed two counties: Rourou County.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties: Rourou County.

translations.literal: Ningren County.
translations.idiomatic: Ningren County.

translations.literal: Later Tang Taizu was born at Xincheng in Shenwu River valley—this was the place.
translations.idiomatic: Later Tang's Taizu was born at Xincheng in the Shenwu River valley—here.

sentences.zh: 初隸朔州，後置州，並寧遠為一縣來屬。

translations.literal: At first subordinate to Shuo Prefecture; later the prefecture was established and together with Ningyuan made one county under it.
translations.idiomatic: Initially under Shuo Prefecture; when the prefecture was set up it merged with Ningyuan into one county.

translations.literal: Five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand registered households.

translations.literal: Yulin County.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin County.

translations.literal: Hebin County.
translations.idiomatic: Hebin County.

translations.literal: Jin Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Su Prefecture.

translations.literal: Chongxi year 12 campaigning against Western Xia established it.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxi year 12, on campaign against Western Xia, it was established.

sentences.zh: 割燕民三百戶、防秋軍一千實之。

translations.literal: Three hundred Yan households and one thousand frontier-season garrison troops were allotted to populate it.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred Yan households and one thousand frontier garrison troops were settled there.

translations.literal: It belonged to the Southwest Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: It came under the Southwest Pacification Office.

translations.literal: Heqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing Army.

sentences.zh: 西夏歸遼，開直路以趨上京。

translations.literal: When Western Xia submitted to Liao a direct route was opened toward Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: After Western Xia submitted to Liao a straight road was opened toward Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 重熙十二年建城，號河清軍。

translations.literal: Chongxi year 12 built the fort, styled Heqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxi year 12 the fort was built and styled Heqing Army.

sentences.zh: 徙民五百戶、防秋兵一千人實之。

translations.literal: Five hundred relocated households and one thousand frontier-season garrison troops were allotted to populate it.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred relocated households and one thousand frontier garrison troops were settled there.

translations.literal: It belonged to the Southwest Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: It came under the Southwest Pacification Office.
